newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 21.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:

* Walt Disney Co is close to buying Cinergi Pictures Entertainment Inc for about $20 million, sources close to the deal said. The deal, which could be completed as early as next week, would give Disney access to Cinergi's library, they said.

* Studio spending on ads for theatrical films topped $1.68 billion in 1996, up 20 percent from 1995, and in the network TV category, spending rose 35 percent to $665 million, according to Competitive Media Reporting.
* Harrison Ford is near a deal to star in the Bosnian drama "The Age of Aquarius", sources said. He was expected to accept a $20 million offer on the film.
* Wes Craven and producing partner Marianne Maddalena have signed a three-film pact with Miramax Films and its Dimension Films. The first film under the deal would be "Scream 2".
* Broadcasters ramped up their timetable for the rollout of digital TV after criticism from the consumer electronics industry and the Federal Communications Commission.
* Director Philip Kaufman is set to bring "The Good Shepherd" to screens for Sony Corp's Columbia Pictures and American Zoetrope Prods.
* Performers in the Screen Actors Guild reported $1.52 billion in earnings last year, nearly 12 percent more than last year.
